annotation.evidence_span: Servers MAY communicate a preferred address of each address family (IPv4 and IPv6)
annotation.interpretation_a: If a server chooses to communicate a preferred address, it must provide one for each address family (both IPv4 and IPv6).
annotation.interpretation_b: A server may communicate a preferred address for only one address family (e.g., only IPv4 or only IPv6) and omit the other.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether a server must provide a preferred address for every address family when it chooses to provide any, leaving two materially different implementation behaviours possible.
